payload.title: Add GitHub Actions deploy workflow for web and infra
payload.description:
Recommended over AWS CodePipeline: the repo already uses GitHub Actions for CI and manual workflow_dispatch for acceptance; no CodePipeline stacks exist and adding one increases idle AWS cost without matching current practice.

Workflow (sketch):
- OIDC role in CDK for GitHub to assume (no long-lived AWS keys in secrets).
- develop merge -> build web/ -> cdk deploy ChatticusWeb + optional ChatticusThinTurn.
- main merge -> staging stacks; production remains workflow_dispatch gated (same pattern as thin-turn production).

Start with workflow_dispatch plus documented manual cdk deploy if OIDC setup is a separate chore. Do not block DNS on full automation.
